newsitem.title: GERMANY: Berlin to sell majority stake in Bewag.
newsitem.headline: Berlin to sell majority stake in Bewag.

text.p: Berlin will sell its 50.8 percent stake in electric utility Bewag for 3.19 billion marks to Southern Co of the U.S., and Germany's Veba AG and Viag AG, Berlin finance minister Annette Fugmann-Heesing said on Tuesday.

Southern will receive a 23.6 percent stake and management control of the company. Veba and Viag, which already hold 10 percent stakes, will receive an additional 13.6 percent each, making their total stakes equal to Southern's.
Fugmann-Heesing said the three companies pledged to hold the 50.8 percent of the company in the new sale for a minimum of 20 years.
If the sale is completed by the end of the year, the three buyers will receive this year's dividend, she said.

The sale will be submitted first to European Union cartel authorities where Fugmann-Heesing said she expects a favourable ruling. If the case is referred then to German cartel authorities, however, she said she fears a negative judgment.
